articles.zh: 足球运动员的大脑里藏着什么？
body: Top footballers are not just fit bodies; their brains are trained too. Scientists say the best players scan the pitch more often and make faster decisions than average players.
顶级球员不只是身体好，他们的大脑也经过训练。科学家发现最优秀的球员会更频繁地扫视球场，比普通球员更快做决定。
Pressure moments like penalties test the mind more than the legs. Players who breathe slowly and follow a fixed routine before the kick usually perform better under stress.
点球这样的高压时刻，考验的更多是心态而不是腿脚。罚球前慢慢呼吸、按固定流程准备的球员，通常在压力下表现更好。
The lesson works off the pitch too. Whether you face an interview or a live video, practising a calm routine helps your brain stay in control.
这个道理在球场之外同样适用。无论你面对的是面试还是直播，练出一套让自己冷静的流程，都能帮大脑稳住阵脚。

articles.en: Why some people are mosquito magnets
articles.zh: 为什么有的人特别招蚊子？
body: Do mosquitoes always choose you at a picnic? Research shows some people really are 'mosquito magnets', and it is mostly about the smell of their skin.
野餐时蚊子总是先咬你吗？研究显示有些人真的是'蚊子磁铁'，原因主要在于皮肤散发的气味。
Certain acids on our skin attract mosquitoes strongly, and this body chemistry hardly changes over time. That is why the same person gets bitten summer after summer.
皮肤上某些酸性物质对蚊子有很强的吸引力，而这种体质几乎不会随时间改变。所以同一个人年年夏天都被咬。
Washing more does not help much, sadly. Experts suggest light-coloured clothes and repellent are still the most practical protection in hot weather.
遗憾的是，多洗澡帮助不大。专家建议，浅色衣服加驱蚊剂仍是炎热天气里最实用的防护。

articles.en: Why singing is surprisingly good for your health
articles.zh: 为什么唱歌对健康有意想不到的好处？
body: Singing is more than fun. When we sing, our breathing becomes deeper and steadier, and the body releases chemicals that lift our mood almost immediately.
唱歌不只是好玩。唱歌时呼吸会变得更深更稳，身体还会释放让心情迅速变好的物质。
Singing with others adds another layer of benefit. Group singers report feeling less lonely, and studies link regular singing to lower stress levels.
和别人一起唱好处更多。合唱的人普遍感觉不那么孤独，研究也发现常唱歌的人压力水平更低。
You do not need a perfect voice to gain these benefits. Experts say singing along with an instrument at home works just as well.
想获得这些好处并不需要完美的嗓音。专家说，在家抱着乐器跟着弹唱效果一样好。
Family dinners can turn into battles, especially when children refuse certain foods. Experts say forcing anyone to eat usually makes the problem worse, not better.
家庭晚餐有时会变成一场战争，尤其当孩子拒绝某些食物时。专家说，强迫任何人吃东西通常只会让问题更糟。
A calmer approach is to keep offering different foods without pressure. Tastes change slowly, and a food we hated as children may become a favourite later.
更从容的做法是不施压地持续提供不同食物。口味是慢慢变化的，小时候讨厌的东西长大后也许会变成最爱。
The real value of a shared meal is the talking, not the menu. A relaxed table helps everyone eat better and feel closer.
一顿家常饭真正的价值在于聊天，而不是菜单。轻松的餐桌能让每个人吃得更好，也更亲近。

articles.zh: 超加工食品到底能不能吃？
body: Ultra-processed foods are everywhere: instant noodles, packaged snacks and sweet drinks. They are cheap, tasty and convenient, which is exactly why we eat so much of them.
超加工食品无处不在：方便面、包装零食、甜饮料。它们便宜、好吃又方便，这正是我们吃得太多的原因。
Scientists worry because these foods are designed to make us keep eating. Diets full of them are linked to weight gain and other health problems.
科学家的担忧在于，这些食品的设计就是让人停不下嘴。长期大量吃这类食品，与体重增加等健康问题相关。
The advice is balance, not fear. Cooking simple meals at home more often is the easiest way to cut down without giving up convenience completely.
建议是保持平衡而不是恐慌。更多在家做简单饭菜，是既不完全放弃便利、又能减少摄入的最简单办法。
